📌 [...] Hi Product Hunt, I'm Shun, the maker of Ownfeed. I've shipped a few small products, and the same thing happened every time: I built it, I launched it, and nobody came. What did work was replying to people who were already describing the problem my product solves. But finding those posts ate up my whole day. So I built the thing I wanted: a feed, like a social timeline, where every post is from someone who might need my product. How it works: - Paste your product's URL. That's the whole setup, no keywords. - Ownfeed reads Reddit, X, Bluesky and Hacker News every day and keeps only the posts where your product can help. - Each post is tagged: Pain point, Looking for a tool, or Mention. - You scroll for five minutes each morning, open the original post, and reply.
